title: pi-laya-router configuration
description: Routing rules for the Laya intent router. Every file in the layer chain (user file, drop-ins, project file) uses this shape; all fields are optional and merge onto the layers below.

provider.description: Pi provider name that owns the target models (the OpenAI-compatible proxy).

name.description: Pi provider name that owns the target models (the OpenAI-compatible proxy).

baseUrl.description: Proxy base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8787/v1. Read at startup only.

provider.description: Pi provider name that owns the target models (the OpenAI-compatible proxy).

baseUrl.description: Proxy base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8787/v1. Read at startup only.

model.description: Laya checkpoint name, e.g. english or a fine-tuned one.
Cheap non-reasoning model used when Laya is unsure or down.

adopt.description: Minimum confidence to adopt a role on the first turn.

switch.description: Minimum confidence for a turn to count as evidence for a switch.

fast.description: Confidence at which a single turn is enough to switch.

margin.description: Minimum gap between the top two roles for a turn to count.

streak.description: Consecutive qualifying turns needed before switching.

cooldownTurns.description: Minimum user turns between two switches.

compactMinTokens.description: Compact on switch only above this context size. Must exceed Pi's compaction.keepRecentTokens.
